text:
morgan: Hey team :wave: Quick heads up — I want to run a 2-week remote pilot from Portugal (Lisbon) Oct 10–24. Couple quick Qs: 1) is the WFH stipend prorated for a short international trip? 2) any payroll/tax nexus or benefits changes I should worry about? 3) what forms do I need to file? cc @people-ops

ava_peopleops: Hey Morgan — nice! Short answers: stipend usually prorated if >7 days overseas, but we need a pre-approval. Please submit the Temporary Remote Request form (link: https://go.redwood/temps-remote). Also include dates and address.

alex_payroll: From payroll POV: for a 2-week trip there is generally no payroll location change. We just need the travel request + confirmation of your homebase staying as your legal work address. No tax withholding changes for <30 days in PT.

sam_tax: tagging to add nuance :thinking: Two weeks is low risk for creating a tax nexus, but caveats: repeated trips, working with local contractors, or setting up a regular office could change that. If you plan any customer meetings where we invoice locally, flag it. I recommend we avoid repeated >30-day stints without a deeper review.

lina_benefits: Benefits remain intact as long as your legal homebase doesn't change. If you change homebase for payroll we’d need to re-run benefits eligibility. For a 2-week pilot, no action on benefits side after you file the form.

jordan_mgr: Approved from my side — coverage OK while you’re out. Please share calendar block and we’ll route urgent pings to Aisha. :thumbsup:

morgan: Thanks all. One small follow-up — is the stipend payment automatic or do I expense?

ava_peopleops: The stipend is handled by payroll but needs approval first. For short pilots we do a prorated one-off payment. After you submit the form I’ll route to Payroll for the prorate calc. Expect a one-time payment on next payroll after approval.

alex_payroll: Yep — payroll will post it as "Temporary Remote Stipend" on the same cycle. If you need faster, let us know and we can do an off-cycle but we prefer normal cycle.

sam_tax: Also — please keep receipts in case we need to justify business-related expenses. Personal travel costs aren’t reimbursed unless pre-approved.

people-ops-bot: Temporary Remote Request submitted (ID: TR-8342) by morgan. Status: pending approvals (manager, people-ops).

morgan: Submitted the form and added calendar blocks. Thanks everyone! :memo:
